channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Derrick Jones | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Derrick Jones from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Bradley Beal, Derrick Jones
item.description:
Tyronn Lue:

“When we first came into the season, we thought we had a great team, we thought we had a great chance. And so when you lose Bradley Beal, when you lose Kawhi, you lose Derrick Jones, you lose Bogie, things can get hard. And so they have been hard for us”

Tyronn Lue on Bradley Beal, Derrick Jones, Dec 9, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: John Collins on Derrick Jones
item.description:
John Collins on Derrick Jones Jr.:

“Just his activity, and his impact, his awareness, his athleticism -- it means a lot more playing against him every day... DJ, been a big surprise for me.”

John Collins on Derrick Jones, Oct 4, 2025. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Chris Fleming on Derrick Jones
item.description:
Rob Schaefer:Acting Bulls coach Chris Fleming on Derrick Jones Jr., who's missing 3rd game with strained hammy:

“Exact timetable, I can't tell you, but I do think he'll be back in the very near future.”

Chris Fleming on Derrick Jones, Dec 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Javonte Green, Derrick Jones
item.description:
KC Johnson:Donovan on life without PWil:

“I think Derrick. I think Javonte. Obviously Alex, we’ve played smaller with 4 guards. A lot is going to be teams and matchups. I thought Lonzo when we were small did a pretty good on Randle, made his postups difficult. All those are viable options”

Billy Donovan on Javonte Green, Derrick Jones, Oct 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Derrick Jones
item.description:
“You know, it was about getting Rondae in the starting lineup, providing some energy, honestly. We’ve got him for 10 more days, and I thought it was a good matchup for him. It wasn’t about not playing Derrick at all — that’s kind of the way it played out, but that wasn’t necessarily the plan going into it. But that was the reason, it wasn’t a decision not to play Derrick.”

Terry Stotts on Derrick Jones, Apr 20, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Langston Galloway on Derrick Jones
item.description:
“Derrick Jones looked down and was like, ‘Bro, those are tough. You have some heat on,'”

Langston Galloway on Derrick Jones, Feb 28, 2019. Source: The Athletic.
